notification_deadline: Within 72 hours of becoming aware of the breach

section_1_nature_of_breach.description: SENTINEL IPS demo incident -- multiple attack vectors detected

likely_consequences: Potential unauthorised access to personal data
Temporary loss of availability of services
Potential credential compromise or session hijacking
Potential persistent access by threat actor
section_3_consequences.severity: HIGH — Likely requires notification to supervisory authority AND data subjects

measures_taken: Malicious IP addresses automatically blocked by SENTINEL IPS
Full packet capture preserved as forensic evidence
Adaptive model retrain scheduled to prevent recurrence
measures_proposed: Notify affected data subjects if high-risk breach confirmed
Conduct penetration test to identify remaining vulnerabilities
